rows.basis: Annual income from employment and other income taxed on the general scale (after the NPD and allowable deductions), residents

rows.label: Self-employed income tax (individuali veikla)
rows.value: 20% on annual taxable profit up to €42,500, reduced by a tax credit (effective 5% up to €20,000, rising to 20% at €42,500); profit above €42,500 on the general 20/25/32% scale
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rules and the individual-activity tax credit follow.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Startup residence permit
rows.value: Yes: temporary residence permit for 2 years (replaceable for 3 years) to found and run an innovative startup, endorsed by the institution authorised by the Minister of the Economy and Innovation; the company must be set up within 120 days; no income threshold or special tax treatment in the law
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rules and the individual-activity tax credit follow.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos įstatymas dėl užsieniečių teisinės padėties Nr. IX-2206, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-11-01 iki 2026-12-31, 40 straipsnio 1 dalies 5-1 punktas ir 45-1 straipsnis

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Remote-work (digital-nomad) permit
rows.value: None: the Law on the Legal Status of Aliens has no residence ground for remote work for a foreign employer; working remotely from abroad for a Lithuanian employer needs no work permit; e-residency gives access to e-services only, not residence
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rules and the individual-activity tax credit follow.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: None: new residents are taxed on the normal scale with the same NPD; residence from 183 days in a tax period
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rules and the individual-activity tax credit follow.
